static_traits.name: Li Kaiwen
static_traits.social_status: Has several friends to talk with, but finds it hard to express feelings of 'not being good enough' to them
static_traits.medical_history: No notable history of physical illness; no prior psychotherapy history; no similar problems experienced before
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude; able to clearly describe troubles; willing to try behavioral experiments

basic_info.main_problem: In recent months, when playing video games I strongly feel incompetent and not good enough; comparing myself with others significantly affects my self-esteem.
basic_info.core_demands: Identify and challenge negative beliefs such as 'I can never compare to others', design and implement behavioral experiments to test and correct these beliefs, thereby relieving inferiority and improving self-evaluation and physical and mental well-being.

special_situations.event: In games, comparing scores or performance with other players
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my progress is not as good as others' or my level is below others', it means I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly comparing with others and seeking external approval to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them / I am not capable

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback or criticism from other players in the game
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others have a negative evaluation of me, it means I am indeed very bad
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding discussing feelings of inferiority with friends; practicing twice as hard to avoid being criticized again

special_situations.event: Failing many times in games or not seeing obvious progress in a short period
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot do well now, I will not get better in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presets the worst outcome and uses pressure to drive oneself to keep practicing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will not get better in the future either / I will never measure up to others

special_situations.event: Even small progress (such as clearing previously difficult levels consecutively) is still overshadowed by memories of failure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching a level equal to or higher than others counts; other progress is not worth being seen
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence, focusing on failure to push oneself to keep exerting effort

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen as capable and good enough
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being evaluated as incompetent, belittled, or excluded
defense_goal: Reducing unease and self-doubt by seeking external approval
Avoids showing vulnerability in front of family and friends to protect self-image

object_relations.self_representation: A learner/player who is not good enough and prone to mistakes
object_relations.object_representation: Others who judge harshly and are better than oneself

manifestations: Hard to discuss feelings of 'not being good enough' and inferiority with friends
In gaming contexts, relying on others' evaluations to define self-worth
outcomes: Sense of self-worth highly dependent on others' evaluations
Motivation for interest activities (such as playing guitar) decreases

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently comparing oneself with others, defining self-worth by others' evaluation
Strengthening self-reproach when receiving negative feedback
Difficulty expressing feelings of vulnerability and inadequacy to friends

exception_events.target_problem: When encountering difficulties or failure in video games, the client usually falls into the thought 'I am terrible / can never compare to others', with low mood and loss of motivation.
exception_events.unique_outcome: When continuously practicing certain previously difficult levels, the client could keep clearing them and see small progress, which differed from the previous experience of 'always failing, with no improvement'.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: focusing on continuous practice of specific levels and accumulating proficiency; contextual clues: there are observable goals and evidence of progress, with clearer short-term feedback.

positive_force: Open attitude toward evidence-based practice and 'behavioral experiments'
Able to notice and acknowledge small progress of their own (such as clearing previously difficult levels consecutively)
Work and basic functioning are stable (kitchen work unaffected)
Has some social support (has a few friends to talk with)
negative_force: Habitually comparing with others, relying on external validation to assess self-worth
Existing cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, disqualifying positive information
Prone to self-negation and low mood after negative feedback and failure
Difficulty expressing vulnerability to friends, support resources are hard to bring effectively into play

target_behavior.behavior: Strong inferiority and self-denial appearing in video game situations
antecedent: 收到其他玩家的负面反馈
与他人比较水平与进步
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates ability with self-worth, driven by cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, overgeneralization, and disqualifying the positive, and relies on external recognition.
target_behavior.function: Escapes the discomfort of being negated, attempting to gain control and recognition through self-criticism and doubled practice.
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem declined, mood low, motivation for other interests (such as playing guitar) reduced, but work performance was not affected.

target_behavior.behavior: Reduces participation in other interest activities (such as playing guitar)
antecedent: Experiencing frustration and low mood after games
target_behavior.core_reason: Generalization of negative emotions leads to decreased motivation, increased expectation of failure.
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible failure and frustration experience in the short term, reducing discomfort.
target_behavior.consequence: Leisure and recovery opportunities decrease, further intensifying the cycle of low mood and declining self-evaluation.
